_comment: Weighted, explainable lead scoring. Each signal that fires contributes its weight (times any multiplier) to the score; leads.csv shows every contribution. Edit weights freely - scripts never hardcode them.

lis_pendens.description: A lis pendens was recorded against the property

cc_case.description: County Civil (-CC-) case: HOA/condo lien, small dollar amount against a (typically) high-equity owner; low investor competition

association_plaintiff.description: Plaintiff is an HOA/condo/community association (name contains ASSN/ASSOCIATION/HOA/CONDOMINIUM)

absentee_owner.description: Owner mailing address differs from the property's site address

out_of_state_owner.description: Owner mailing address is outside the property's state

entity_owned.description: Owner is an entity (LLC/INC/TRUST/CORP), not an individual

long_tenure.description: Owner has held the property a long time (equity proxy)

vacant_land_flag.description: Property use indicates vacant land - informational column only by default; raise the weight if vacant parcels are a target

provisional_record.description: Record flagged U (recorded, not yet released) - informational; re-check after release
